messages:
Samira: heads-up — CI started failing on the judge pipeline after the pairwise-arbiter change, looks like a consistency/regression signal. anyone seen this?
Jin: saw it this morning. flaky fail in TestJudgeConsistency, triad/intransitive count spiked. not a perf OOM, it's about voting cycles.
Owen: can you paste the CI error? I didn't getalerts.
Samira: here's the failing snippet from the runner log:
```
--- FAIL: TestJudgeConsistency (0.23s)
    judge_test.go:88: intransitive majority detected on dataset 'webq-ads' (triads=41, threshold=10)
```
Maya: ugh. I rolled in the pairwise tie-breaker heuristics yesterday, maybe the new ordering made some cycles more likely.
Diego: quick recap: arbiter now runs pairwise comparisons across judge-lite-quant, judge-base, judge-ensemble and picks majority. If a triad A>B, B>C, C>A appears we mark it as intransitive.
Jin: right — the metric we added is `pairwise_triad_rate`. It was low on staging but jumped on full dataset. Seems correlated with quantized judge-lite behaviors (answers close but confidences miscalib).
Samira: thoughts on immediate mitigation? reverting the arbiter is expensive for the rollout path.
Owen: temporary mitigation: change tie-break policy to prefer the highest calibrated score instead of strict majority when triad detected. quick patch in runner: fallback to max(calibrated_confidence).
Maya: I can push that patch to the runner in ~30m. but we should also add better triad logging so we can inspect examples.
Diego: adding triad logging + payload sample (prompt + 3 outputs + confidences) is good. but careful with PII — scrub with `scrub_text()` before storing.
Jin: adding CI gate too: fail if `pairwise_triad_rate > 0.02` on evaluation harness for judge-model bringups. That'll block problematic rollouts.
Samira: agreed. also let's add a small, focused bias checklist for triad examples: ensure triads aren't concentrated on demographic prompts. we don't want a calibration bug masking systemic bias.
Maya: noted. I'll add a quick check: compute demographic lift by grouping prompts tagged with `person-attribute` and ensure triad rate there < global * 1.5.
Owen: for longer term: we should detect 'intransitivity clusters' and run a micro-eval that reweights examples by lexical diversity to see if it's due to paraphrase sensitivity.
Diego: FYI I re-ran the quantized judge-lite on a sampled subset and reproduced triads. seems quantization increased near-threshold outputs and made confidences jittery.
Jin: can we try temperature-smoothing on the judge logits pre-calibration? small change but might stabilize decisions without reverting quantization.
Maya: yes — temp=1.2 smoothing helped locally. I'll add an A/B in the harness: `judge_confidence.smoothing_temp` param.
Samira: okay plan: 1) Maya push fallback-to-calibrated patch to runner (hotfix) 2) Diego add triad logging + PII scrub 3) Jin add CI gate and metric alarm 4) Owen start micro-eval for lexical diversity 5) Maya run temp-smoothing A/B.
eval-bot: CI Job #4821 failed — TestJudgeConsistency. Logs: http://internal.redwood/ci/4821/logs — triad_rate=0.037, triads=41.
Diego: re triad samples — I'll attach 10 anonymized examples to the bug and ping @samira for review.
Owen: +1 on adding a dashboard panel for `pairwise_triad_rate` and `judge_confidence_entropy` across model variants. helps spot regressions early.
Samira: good. also add alert when triad_rate increases >5x from baseline in a 1h window. we should catch rollout-related spikes.
Jin: I'll update the harness README and CI docs with the new gate and a small note: "When intransitive triads exceed threshold, prefer calibrated confidence fallback and open an oncall ticket."
Maya: pushing hotfix now. I'll post the PR in this thread.
Samira: thanks — please include the quick rollback plan in the PR description. if fallback works we can leave pairwise arbiter but require the extra gates for bringups. :thumbsup:
Maya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/834 — hotfix + triad logging.
Diego: grabbing triad samples next. ping me if you want live repro.
Jin: nice, once PR lands I'll kick a full harness run against the new judge-lite quant snapshot.
Samira: awesome — keeping this thread for notes. we'll reconvene if CI still flakes after the hotfix.
